info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Event Notification Management API
info.description: The Event Notification Management API enables organizations to facilitate real-time event notifications related to open banking operations. This API allows clients to publish and manage notifications for significant events, ensuring timely communication of updates and changes. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers integrating open banking functionalities into their applications. By leveraging this API, clients can enhance user engagement and streamline transaction processes through automated notifications.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new event notification, which can be used to alert users or systems about specific events.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send event notifications to the server. The payload should contain relevant event details formatted in JSON, which will trigger the appropriate actions on the server.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing is not yet complete.
